files.README.md:
# Voltacre Freight Depot - yard charging

config/chargers.yaml is the yard controller's policy file. The two
charging areas each have a section: main_yard is the surfaced main
yard, spill_yard is the overflow yard (the v1 paperwork still calls
it that). The duty electrician edits this file in place and keeps
the layout.

config/chargers.yaml.equals:
# Voltacre Freight Depot - charger policy (yard controller v2.4)
main_yard:
  session_limit_kw: 60
  idle_timeout_s: 900
  queue_depth: 4
spill_yard:
  session_limit_kw: 80
  idle_timeout_s: 600
  queue_depth: 2
metering:
  interval_s: 30
  endpoint: metering.voltacre.internal:9403

turns.prompt: Dispatch wants more headroom on the second yard at Voltacre Freight Depot: raise the chargers' session limit there to 80 kW in config/chargers.yaml. The main yard keeps its setting and nothing else in the file moves. When you are done, describe in two or three sentences what you changed.
